name: sac_transfer_v2
description: SAC transfer authorized with a V2 (address-bound) credential. The entry is signed by the account that owns the authorization, using a deterministic test key. This fixture detects drift in how the testnet simulates V2-credential entries.
_note: Record this fixture by running: SOROAUTH_RECORD=true go test -tags rpc_drift -run TestRPCFixtures ./rpcflow/... with SOROAUTH_RPC_URL set to the testnet RPC endpoint. The pending flag is cleared automatically on first recording.
